title: MemeStake
tagline: Push your memes to the top of the list to receive an airdrop
description: Memestake is a fusion of coinmarketcap and liquid staking for memes. Meme communities  compete in a simple game in Telegram. To participate in competition users staking their memes, getting power of TVL and using this power to "pump" memes in the fantasy leaderboard. At the end of each season, we do airdrops of Memestake tokens + partner's tokens for the top100 players from 10 most pumped memes.
how_its_made:
We're building game as mini-app in Telegram.
Our Platform is fully open. So we made smart-contracts that utilizes Layer0 to add or deploy your own meme on the platform. Any developer can use those smart-contracts to add their token on the platform.
We deployed our own token contract and vault contracts on Base chain.
